model_version_note: The contract version and the model version are separate facts. Contract v2 is a container change: it adds fields for observations. The numbers in it were produced by model version 3.0.0. Model version 4.0.0 is reserved for when V4 is genuinely complete and is not claimed by this artifact.

grid_factor.source: EPA eGRID2023 Rev 2 (data year 2023, released 2025-06-12), SRVC subregion, total output emission rate CO2e

conventions.horizon_label_change: v1 used 'now' for the baseline year. v2 uses 'baseline': 'now' is time-relative text frozen into a dated artifact, and reads as false the moment the artifact is a year old.

relationship_to_v1: ADDITIVE. Every v1 field is present with identical semantics and identical values for the same run.
v1 is FROZEN. Nothing regenerates or edits it. Its manifest digest is pinned by a test.
A consumer written against v1 can read a v2 row and get the same answers.
v2 adds 12 fields carrying what the V4 field-data loop produces, which v1 had nowhere to put.
consumer_rules: Join on site_id only; site_name is display text.
MATLAB refuses feasibility claims when capacity_basis is not verified_utility/verified_facility.
Excel/Tableau/presentation quote contract values; no re-derivation.
Any schema change bumps contract_version; consumers assert the major version.
An empty observed_* field means NOT OBSERVED. It never means zero.
